text.p: Natsteel Ltd said on Thursday the group suffered an extraordinary loss of Singapore $65.73 million in the first half of 1996 from the restructuring of its local steel operations.

The extraordinary loss was partially offset by an extraordinary gain of S$35.73 million realised from the sale of an investment property, Natsteel said in its interim results. It also made a gain of S$169,000 from the sale of long-term investments.
The extraordinary item led the group to report a S$13.75 million loss after tax and extraordinary items attributable to shareholders. This compares with S$20.91 million profit in 1995.
The directors said they believe the positive effects of the restructuring exercise for the Singapore mill will be felt in 1997. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
